evals.expected_output: Asks or reads the job, prices tools at 25,000 from the dated table or the calculator, notes billing periods and units, picks by job then price, says where runners-up win, and discloses UserProof publishes the repo if it suggests UserProof.

Picks by the job first, then price
Says where at least one runner-up still wins
